metas.name: The Marvel Super Heroes
metas.description: Stories spotlight Marvel comic book characters Captain America, The Incredible Hulk, Iron Man, The Mighty Thor and The Sub-Mariner.

metas.name: Spider-Man
metas.description: Original cartoon series based on the web-slinging Marvel comic book character, Peter Parker, who, after being bit by a radioactive spider, assumes extraordinary powers.

metas.name: Fantastic Four
metas.description: Four costumed superheroes battle the world's most terrifying villains.

metas.name: Fantastic Four
metas.description: The super-elastic Mr. Fantastic, the force field-wielding Invisible Girl, the orange rock-covered Thing and the data-crammed robot H.E.R.B.I.E. make up a team of superheroes dedicated to thwarting would-be world-dominating villains.

metas.name: Fred and Barney Meet the Thing
metas.description: A show featuring two different cartoon segments,The New Fred and Barney Show (a revival of The Flintstones) and The Thing (based on the Marvel Comics superhero).

metas.name: Spider-Woman
metas.description: The adventures of a female superhero with spider-like abilities.

metas.name: Spider-Man
metas.description: Bitten by a radioactive spider, Peter Parker gains spider-like abilities that he uses to fight crime in New York City as Spider-Man, battling villains like the Green Goblin, Vulture, and Doctor Octopus.

metas.name: Spider-Man and His Amazing Friends
metas.description: Spider-Man battles crime in New York City with the help of Iceman and Firestar.

metas.name: Incredible Hulk
metas.description: A research scientist is cursed with the tendency to turn into a giant green brute under stress.

metas.name: Pryde of the X-Men
metas.description: Just as teenage mutant Kitty Pryde is welcomed to the X-Men, the team of mutant heroes are called into battle to prevent Magneto and his Brotherhood of Evil Mutants from crashing a comet into the Earth.

metas.name: X-Men
metas.description: Follows a team of mutant superheroes called the X-Men, who fight against bigotry and hatred for being different while striving for justice and human acceptance in the Marvel comic book universe.

metas.name: Iron Man
metas.description: Industrialist Tony Stark leads his private team of superheros as Iron Man against the forces of evil.

metas.name: Fantastic Four
metas.description: The adventures of Marvel Comic's greatest superhero team.

metas.name: Spider-Man: The Animated Series
metas.description: A young man with spider-like abilities fights crime as a superhero in New York City while trying to have a normal personal life.

metas.name: UltraForce
metas.description: Ultras... Once ordinary people, now super-human, spread terror across the globe. Enemies of peace include Rune, Lord Pumpkin, and Sludge. The U.S. government forms a team led by Hardcase, 1st Ultra to publicly reveal himself, to p...

metas.name: The Incredible Hulk
metas.description: A nuclear scientist is afflicted with the tendency to change into a powerful green monster under stress.

metas.name: Men in Black
metas.description: The continuing adventures of Agents K and J as they deal with problems with extraterrestrials in New York City.

metas.name: Silver Surfer
metas.description: The adventures of the cosmic wanderer as he seeks his lost home after rebelling from his master.

metas.name: Spider-Man Unlimited
metas.description: Spider-Man travels to Counter-Earth to rescue a Terran shuttle crew trapped there and discovers a tyrannical and warped version of his world.

metas.name: Avengers: United They Stand
metas.description: The adventures of the Marvel Comics Universe's greatest general membership superhero team.

metas.name: X-Men: Evolution
metas.description: This rendition of X-Men features Cyclops, Jean Grey, Rogue, Nightcrawler, Shadowcat and Spike as teenagers as they fight for a world that fears and hates them.

metas.name: Spider-Man: The New Animated Series
metas.description: A young man with spider like abilities fights crime as a superhero in New York City while trying to have a normal personal life.

metas.name: Ultimate Avengers
metas.description: To confront an alien menace, General Fury assembles a team of superheroes lead by a recently resuscitated Captain America.

metas.name: Ultimate Avengers 2
metas.description: When the Chitauri invaders are sighted in the African kingdom of Wakanda, the Avengers covertly enter the advanced nation to investigate.

metas.name: Fantastic Four: World's Greatest Heroes
metas.description: The adventures of the Marvel Universe's premiere superhero family.

metas.name: X-Men: Darktide
metas.description: X-Men Unite! From an abandoned oil rig, Magneto, Mystique and Juggernaut prepare to unleash a weapon that will destroy all human life! Cyclops, Jean Grey, Wolverine, Beast and Archangel race to save Storm from their clutches, but first, they'll have to stop the rampaging giant Sentinels programmed to destroy them!

metas.name: The Invincible Iron Man
metas.description: When a cocky industrialist's efforts to raise an ancient Chinese temple leads him to be seriously wounded and captured by enemy forces, he must use his ideas for a revolutionary power armor in order to fight back as a superhero.

metas.name: Doctor Strange: The Sorcerer Supreme
metas.description: A crippled and embittered doctor travels to a hidden community in Tibet where he learns of his true destiny as the Sorcerer Supreme of his world.

metas.name: The Spectacular Spider-Man
metas.description: An animated television show that focuses on a sixteen-year-old Peter Parker, and the origins of Spider-Man.

metas.name: Next Avengers: Heroes of Tomorrow
metas.description: The children of the Avengers hone their powers and go head to head with the very enemy responsible for their parents' demise.

metas.name: Iron Man: Armored Adventures
metas.description: A teenage Tony Stark battles evil with his revolutionary power armor technology.

metas.name: Wolverine and the X-Men
metas.description: After an explosion at the school, the X-Men went their separate ways. But they must unite once again under the leadership of Wolverine to prevent an inevitable war while also dealing with present problems.

metas.name: Hulk Vs.
metas.description: Two stories featuring Marvel's anti-hero The Incredible Hulk and his encounters with the X-Man Wolverine and the god known as Thor.

metas.name: Spider-Woman, Agent of S.W.O.R.D.
metas.description: After the failed alien invasion of Earth, revenge-seeking P.I. Jessica Drew, a.k.a. Spider-Woman, is recruited by S.W.O.R.D., an agency specialized in eliminating alien threats, to track down the remaining aliens disguised as humans.

metas.name: The Super Hero Squad Show
metas.description: Marvel's greatest heroes and evilest of villains battle it out in action packed, yet somewhat satirical alternate universe-style adventures.

metas.name: Astonishing X-Men
metas.description: An alien species attempts to take over earth, but the X-Men are ready for anything.

metas.name: Black Panther
metas.description: Black Panther is the ruler and protector of the African nation of Wakanda. Using technology, wits, and extraordinary fighting ability he must protect his nation from an invasion led by Ulysses Klaw, the man who killed his father.

metas.name: Planet Hulk
metas.description: The Incredible Hulk, ejected from Earth in a spaceship, crash-lands on a planet ruled by a tyrant, who forces him to fight in a coliseum against other powerful creatures. The Hulk reluctantly befriends the combatants on his team.

metas.name: Iron Man: Extremis
metas.description: An experimental serum called Extremis gets stolen, and Iron Man rockets into action. The ensuing battles test Stark's spirit and Iron Man's power. Based on the graphic novel of the same name.

metas.name: The Avengers: Earth's Mightiest Heroes
metas.description: After 74 villains break out of prison, Marvel's most powerful superheroes team up to capture all of them, and also to defend the Earth from widespread threats.

metas.name: Marvel Anime: Iron Man
metas.description: When Tony Stark branches his company into Japan, he is opposed by the nefarious Zodiac organization. It's up to Stark's Iron Man to defeat the Zodiac, and defend Japan.

metas.name: Marvel Anime: X-Men
metas.description: X-Men, still grieving over the death of Phoenix (Jean Grey), are investigating a case of a missing mutant girl in Northern Japan. This leads them to a mysterious virus that turns mutants into monsters. U-Men and the Inner Circle w...

metas.name: Thor & Loki: Blood Brothers
metas.description: A serious motion comic drama about Loki, who becomes the ruler of Asgard after a successful coup, only to realize that even gods must deal with hard political choices. But does anything matter if even fate itself is against you?

metas.name: Thor: Tales of Asgard
metas.description: The young Norse god Thor embarks on a quest with his brother Loki to find and recover a legendary sword.

metas.name: Marvel Anime: Blade
metas.description: Legendary half-vampire, half-human vampire hunter Blade is tracking Deacon Frost, a very powerful and influential vampire who killed his mother and who heads Existence, a secretive vampire organization that operates in Southeast A...

metas.name: Marvel Anime: Wolverine
metas.description: Logan is asked by his old friend, a cop from Japan, to help him take down Shingen Yashida's crime syndicate and save Mariko, Logan's lost love, from forced marriage arranged by her father Shingen. Yukio, a female assassin, helps him.

metas.name: Ultimate Spider-Man
metas.description: Spider-Man battles evil with a new team of teen colleagues and training from S.H.I.E.L.D.

metas.name: Avengers Assemble
metas.description: The further adventures of the Marvel Universe's mightiest general membership superhero team.

metas.name: Iron Man: Rise of Technovore
metas.description: Iron Man is framed by a technological terrorist and breaks out to clear his name.

metas.name: Inhumans
metas.description: Black Bolt and his Royal Family, Medusa, Karnak, Gorgon, Triton, Crystal, Maximus the Mad and Lockjaw, try to protect the city of Attilan from enemies within and outside.

metas.name: Wolverine: Origin
metas.description: An animated look at the origin of Wolverine

metas.name: Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H.
metas.description: The Incredible Hulk teams up with Red Hulk, She-Hulk, Skaar, and Rick Jones aka A-Bomb to battle the forces of evil in front of cameras for Rick's web-based series to show the Hulk is more hero than monster.

metas.name: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Maximum Overload
metas.description: Spider-Man and Marvel's Super Heroes take on a mischievous Loki and a team of super villains.

metas.name: Iron Man and Hulk: Heroes United
metas.description: The Invincible Iron Man and the Incredible Hulk must join forces to save the Earth from its greatest threat yet.

metas.name: Wolverine vs. Sabretooth
metas.description: Trailer for Wolverine Versus Sabretooth

metas.name: Avengers Confidential: Black Widow & Punisher
metas.description: After interfering with a top secret mission, THE PUNISHER is taken into custody by S.H.I.E.L.D. AGENT and AVENGER, BLACK WIDOW. At the orders of Director Nick Fury, Punisher and Black Widow...

metas.name: Marvel Disk Wars: The Avengers
metas.description: A group of teenagers join forces with the Avengers, Earth's mightiest heroes, to fight against the tyrannical Loki and his mighty empire.

metas.name: Iron Man & Captain America: Heroes United
metas.description: Iron Man and Captain America battle to keep the Red Skull and his triggerman, Taskmaster, from unleashing an army of Hydra Brutes on the world.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: A special bond develops between plus-sized inflatable robot Baymax and prodigy Hiro Hamada, who together team up with a group of friends to form a band of high-tech heroes.

metas.name: Wolverine Weapon X: Tomorrow Dies Today
metas.description: It’s the debut of an all-new, all-different Deathlok. Killer cyborgs have come from the future to kill the heroes of today, while Wolverine embarks on an international pub crawl with a certain recently reborn Sentinel of Liberty. Beer and bullets galore!

metas.name: Marvel Knights: Eternals
metas.description: Medical student Mark Curry's world is turned upside down when he meets Ike Harris, a man who believes that he is part of a centuries-old race of super-powered beings put here on Earth by aliens to preserve and safeguard the planet, and even crazier, tries to convince Mark that he is one too.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: The adventures of a band of space warriors who work to protect the universe from the evil overlord Thanos.

metas.name: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Avengers Reassembled
metas.description: The Avengers are forced to "party" with Ultron when he seeks to disassemble the team by taking control of Iron Man's armor and enact a nefarious scheme to take over the world.

metas.name: Marvel Super Hero Adventures: Frost Fight!
metas.description: The Marvel Heroes unite to try and stop Loki and the frost giant Ymir from conquering the world as the duo try to steal Santa's powers to do so.

metas.name: Wolverine Versus Sabretooth: Reborn
metas.description: Wolverine and Sabretooth have been locked in an endless grudge match that goes back longer than either can remember: or even imagine. The key to victory is eons old, and it’s certain to rock their world. It’s the epic conclusion to the duo’s greatest battle!

metas.name: Hulk: Where Monsters Dwell
metas.description: Doctor Strange and a team of monsters must help the Hulk overcome his dream self in order to defeat Nightmare on Halloween night.

metas.name: Marvel Future Avengers
metas.description: follows a young boy named Makoto, who gains superpowers due to an evil gene manipulation experiment. Makoto and other young kids with powers join the Avengers as apprentices named "Future Avengers."

metas.name: Spider-Man
metas.description: Peter Parker, a new student at the famous Horizon High, fights evil super-villains as the costumed superhero, Spider-Man.

metas.name: Big Hero 6: The Series
metas.description: Teen genius Hiro Hamada, Baymax the robot, and their friends defend the city of San Fransokyo as superheroes.

metas.name: Marvel Super Hero Adventures
metas.description: Our favorite crime-fighting super hero, Spider-Man, is back with more amazing adventures and, with the help of both old and new super hero friends, recounts the important lessons he’s learned along the way.

metas.name: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes - Guardians of the Galaxy: The Thanos Threat
metas.description: The Guardians are on a mission to deliver the Build Stone to the Avengers before the Ravagers, Thanos and his underlings steal it from them.

metas.name: Marvel's Rocket & Groot
metas.description: Before becoming Guardians of the Galaxy, Rocket and Groot were bounty hunters trying to get a ship.

metas.name: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes - Black Panther: Trouble in Wakanda
metas.description: Ulysses Klaue and Eric Killmonger are back to loot Wakanda's Vibrainium mines, this time with the help of the mad titan Thanos. Can Black Panther thwart their evil plot, even with the aid of Earth's Mightiest Heroes?

metas.name: Marvel Rising: Secret Warriors
metas.description: Teen superheroes Ms Marvel, Squirrel Girl, Quake, Patriot, America Chavez and Inferno unite to take down a threat approaching the universe.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.description: Teen Miles Morales becomes the Spider-Man of his universe and must join with five spider-powered individuals from other dimensions to stop a threat for all realities.

metas.name: Marvel Rising: Initiation
metas.description: Gwen Stacy AKA Ghost-Spider, wrongly accused of a crime she didn’t commit, seeks to clear her name and deliver justice. Unfortunately, her dad is not only Captain of the NYPD, but spearheading the manhunt! To make matters worse, other young heroes—Ms. Marvel, Squirrel Girl, Quake and Patriot—are after Ghost Spider as well. But, as the chase to uncover the truth winds down, a darker threat looms along the horizon, and very soon, these heroes will need to put aside their differences and work together as a team.

metas.name: Marvel Rising: Heart of Iron
metas.description: Riri Williams feels socially isolated because she is young for a college student. Hala the Accuser destroys the school's engineering lab and kidnaps Riri's best friend. inspired by Iron Man, Riri hatches a plan to save the day.

metas.name: LEGO Marvel Spider-Man: Vexed by Venom
metas.description: Spider-Man must stop the Green Goblin and Venom from stealing technology that could ultimately destroy New York City.

metas.name: LEGO Avengers: Climate Conundrum
metas.description: The Environmental Clean-up Conference is off to anything but a smooth start when Tony Stark realizes his fellow competitor is his rival Justin Hammer!

metas.name: Marvel Battleworld: Mystery of the Thanostones
metas.description: Can Iron Man and this rag-tag group - Captain Marvel, Spider-Ham, Groot, and Throg - figure out what the Mad Titan Thanos wants and why they've been brought to this strange, new world?

metas.name: M.O.D.O.K.
metas.description: It centers around an egomaniacal supervillain with a really big head and a really little body, who struggles to maintain control of his evil organization and his demanding family.

metas.name: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
metas.description: Follow Peter Parker, Gwen Stacy, and Miles Morales and their adventures as the young heroes team up with Hulk, Ms. Marvel, and Black Panther to take down foes like Rhino, Doc Ock, and Green Goblin.

metas.name: What If...?
metas.description: Exploring pivotal moments from the Marvel Cinematic Universe and turning them on their head, leading the audience into uncharted territory.

metas.name: Hit-Monkey
metas.description: It tells the tale of a wronged Japanese snow monkey, mentored by the ghost of an American assassin, as he cuts a wide swath through the Tokyo underworld.

metas.name: Super Crooks
metas.description: Johnny Bolt recruits a group of ragtag supervillains for one last heist. Their target: A ruthless super-powered crime boss. What can go wrong?

metas.name: LEGO Avengers: Loki in Training
metas.description: Loki declares he wants to be an Avenger, so Iron Man decides to make Loki an "Avenger In Training." It's a great plan until Thanos arrives on Earth looking for Loki.

metas.name: Baymax!
metas.description: The characters in the unique city of Big Hero 6 get their own series, packed with adventures.

metas.name: I Am Groot
metas.description: A series of shorts featuring the seedling Groot along with several new and unusual characters.

metas.name: LEGO Avengers: Time Twisted
metas.description: When Thanos steals the quantum tunnel, the Avengers embark on a mission to stop him from changing history.

metas.name: Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur
metas.description: After 13-year-old super-genius Lunella accidentally brings ten-ton T-Rex Devil Dinosaur into present-day New York City via a time vortex, the duo works together to protect the city's Lower East Side from danger.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
metas.description: Traveling across the multiverse, Miles Morales meets a new team of Spider-People, made up of heroes from different dimensions. But when the heroes clash over how to deal with a new threat, Miles finds himself at a crossroads.

metas.name: LEGO Avengers: Code Red
metas.description: The Avengers meet a dangerous new foe quite unlike anything they've ever encountered before.

metas.name: X-Men '97
metas.description: A band of mutants use their uncanny gifts to protect a world that hates and fears them; they're challenged like never before, forced to face a dangerous and unexpected new future.

metas.name: LEGO Avengers: Mission Demolition
metas.description: After battles, Damage Control cleans up messes. But when a villain targets the Avengers, an unlikely hero - a clumsy worker who breaks everything - might be Earth's only hope to become the hero he dreams of and save Earth's Heroes.

metas.name: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
metas.description: Peter Parker is on his way to becoming a hero, but his path to get there is anything but ordinary.

metas.name: Eyes of Wakanda
metas.description: Wakandan warriors who, throughout history, have traveled the world to retrieve dangerous vibranium artifacts.

metas.name: Marvel Zombies
metas.description: After the Avengers are overtaken by a zombie plague, a group of survivors discover the key to bringing an end to the super-powered undead, racing across a dystopian landscape and risking their lives to save their world.

metas.name: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
metas.description: Follow the adventures (and misadventures) of best friends and super geniuses, Tony Stark, Riri Williams and Amadeus Cho as they work together to solve problems both big and small and protect their city.

metas.name: LEGO Marvel Avengers: Strange Tails
metas.description: Hawkeye and The Avengers have made saving the world look easy. But now they face their wildest threat yet: SOCIAL MEDIA. To save the world, a new team must be recruited to help our heroes contend with an influencer bent on cataclysmic destruction.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse
metas.description: After leaving off from Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse, the story continues.
